pattern: internal const string Repository="[^"]+";\r?\n\s*internal const string ApiUrl="[^"]+";
template:
internal const string Repository="https://github.com/zhangleoxue-blip/myfinder-device-battery";
        internal const string ApiUrl="https://api.github.com/repos/zhangleoxue-blip/myfinder-device-battery/releases";
rationale: For a public release under LeoZhang, the in-app source link and one-click updater must point at the publisher's own repository. Otherwise users of this build would be updated to upstream packages.
compliance: CREDITS.md retains the original upstream URL, author and license; AppId and ZipName are intentionally unchanged.
requires: A signed Release in this repository (SHA256SUMS.txt + .sig) using the matching private key. Until then, the updater simply reports no new version.
